messages:
maya: Quick plan — we're toggling `prefill_cache` to unlock the new route tonight at 23:30 UTC. Ramp: 0% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% over ~40m. Pin service to v3.0.0-rc2 for the window. If anything, rollback to v2.9.8 and disable flag. Need preflight + SRE ack.

owen: Release lead ack. I'll coordinate check-ins. Preflight at 21:45 UTC?

ravi: SRE ack. Setting alert window and auto-rollback hooks. Conditions: p50 > 250ms for 5m OR error-rate > 0.9%. Will also mute noisy alerts in the 23:00-01:00 window.

deploybot: Preflight requested:
```
/deploybot preflight --svc=proxy --ver=v3.0.0-rc2 --flag=prefill_cache
```
Preflight result: smoke ok, auth ok, canary error-rate 0.01%, db migrations N/A.

ops-bot: scheduled job prefill-job-44 at 23:15 UTC to warm caches.

maya: exact rollout commands in runbook:
```
# manual confirms at each step
/deploybot flag set prefill_cache on --pct 2
# wait 6-12m smoke
/deploybot flag set prefill_cache on --pct 10
# soak 12-20m
/deploybot flag set prefill_cache on --pct 50
```
Emergency rollback:
```
/deploybot flag set prefill_cache off --force
/deploybot pin svc proxy --ver v2.9.8 --reason "emergency rollback"
```

owen: I'll take screenshots and lightweight customer-impact checks at each holdpoint.

ravi: gating logic: add a short-circuit to drain new connections when error-rate spikes before rolling back traffic. Also will page primary SRE if auto-rollback runs.

maya: runbook links:
- https://internal/runbooks/prefill-cutover
- telemetry: https://telemetry/redwood/prefill?ts=1723456789
- artifacts: /artifacts/prefill/1723456789

deploybot: rollout job 99214 created; will post ticks and use channel mentions.

ops-bot: warming started :seedling: job prefill-job-44 running

owen: preflight looks good. timeline: preflight 21:45, priming 23:15, thumbs 23:25, start 23:30.

maya: good. pinning note: leave pin for 2h post-ramp then evaluate rollback or promotion to GA.

ravi: oncall confirmed. I'll be on watch and will escalate if anomalies.

maya: anything else?

owen: none. thumbs.

maya: closing. I'll post the release note summary after 50% green. If we hit auto-rollback, reopen thread.
